title: OMIR Entity (R1)
description: A named thing extracted from memory — a person, place, organization, concept, technology, product, skill, or discriminative keyword. OMM level 3.

labels.description: One or more type labels. Open at the edges via 'other' + extension.

summary.description: Context summary built from surrounding relationships.

salience.description: How important this entity is (0..1). Higher salience = stronger gravitational pull in retrieval.

properNoun.description: Proper nouns carry higher base salience than common nouns.

extension.description: E.g. name embeddings (model + vector) ride here; embeddings are NOT core in R1.
